question: Can persistent species-level calibration error in the strongest fixed q comparator explain the apparent within-species route-night dependence and concentration?
population: Exactly the 2,835 weather-eligible strictly-prior-history pairs and fixed q matrices from the 72-h rainfall common-environment comparator.

calibration.split: Existing deterministic SHA256 route fold A/B.
calibration.training_data: All fixed-support species x stop wetter-survey outcomes and their fixed q values in the training route fold.
calibration.model: For each species fit one calibration intercept b_s with logit(p)=logit(q)+b_s by maximum likelihood.
calibration.application: Apply b_s only to focal routes in the opposite fold, then solve one pair-level common logit shift so expected total wet incidence again equals the observed total.

simulation.generator: Independent Bernoulli from the recalibrated, pair-rematched q values.

endpoints.concentration: Existing conditional concentration residual controlling simulated route-new-taxon and total extra-stop coefficients.
endpoints.bounded_dependence: Existing bounded rho_b among dry-route-silent taxa, evaluated against recalibrated q.
endpoints.far_lag: Existing pooled lag 7-9 residual coefficient among dry-route-silent taxa, evaluated against recalibrated q.

decision.species_miscalibration_sufficient: All observed endpoints fall within their independent recalibrated-null 95% reference intervals / concentration residual envelope.
decision.residual_route_night_dependence_after_sp: Concentration remains above its upper 95% residual bound and both bounded-dependence and far-lag diagnostics remain above their independent-null upper 95% bounds.

interpretation.residual: A route-night shared component remains after cross-fitted species-level marginal calibration, so constant species under/overprediction is insufficient.
interpretation.boundary: This still does not identify a biological lower-level mechanism.

anti_tuning: Do not change calibration eligibility, folds, q source, pair rematching, simulation count, seed, endpoint formulas or tails after readback.
